reason: Adds new hash join v2 support for left outer semi join, which directly changes join-result semantics and executor correctness for a central SQL operator. It touches `pkg/planner/core/physical_plans.go`, executor join probe paths, and `pkg/expression/expression.go`, with extra spill/queue changes that can affect runtime behavior under memory pressure. This is exactly the kind of planner/executor semantic change that can hide wrong-result High issues.
